text: We hope for the swift speed of the arrow, O Vrishaanka, for the task you have undertaken for us, which is the fulfillment of our vow. Now, hear this: the portion of the sacrifice belongs to the slayer of enemies; this is what the enemies desire. The gods, desiring your victory, are eager to bestow upon you the power of your valor. And Brahma, whose body is composed of your essence, is united with you, and thus he is accomplished through your single strike.
